what.title: What
what.text: A holistic map of consciousness and energy: ancient practices, a vibration scale, the zodiac and numerology, and living-food nutrition — joined into one whole.

why.title: Why
why.text: A person is not only a mind, a body or a birth chart. When you understand your nature, know your vibration, practise and eat what is alive, change stops being fleeting and becomes lasting.

how.title: How
how.text: Every part is presented clearly and honestly: steps, benefits and contraindications, sources and traditions, with science kept distinct from wisdom. Practise safely, at your own pace.

techniques.title: Technique Library
techniques.subtitle: Explore {count} practices across breathwork, meditation, yoga, and more.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: ConsciousEnergy exists to make ancient transformative practices accessible to everyone. We believe that breathwork, meditation, yoga, and energy work are not esoteric curiosities — they are humanity's most time-tested technologies for well-being, self-understanding, and expanded consciousness.

disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: The practices on this website are for educational purposes only. They are not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning any new practice, especially if you have a medical condition. Some practices listed here may be intense — please read contraindications carefully.

map.title: The Vibration Map
map.intro: Three classic frameworks for mapping inner states — Dr. David Hawkins’ Map of Consciousness, the sacred Solfeggio frequencies, and the seven-chakra energy system — woven into one unified map. Explore where your energy lives today, and the practices that help it rise.

scale.heading: The Unified Scale
scale.caption: Seven tiers from dense to expansive, each aligning a chakra, a Hawkins band, and a Solfeggio tone. Tap a tier to see how the models meet.
scale.tapHint: Select a tier to explore it.

tabs.heading: The Three Models
tabs.caption: See each framework on its own, then how our unified map draws them together.

assessment.heading: Where Are You Now?
assessment.intro: Answer eight short questions to find the tier closest to your present state — and practices to support your next step. This is a reflective tool, not a diagnosis.
assessment.resultLead: Right now your energy rests here.

disclaimer.title: A Map, Not a Verdict
disclaimer.text: These frameworks are contemplative and symbolic, not scientific measurements. Hawkins’ calibrations and the Solfeggio frequencies are spiritual models, and the self-assessment reflects only this moment. Use the map as an invitation to practice and self-inquiry — never as a fixed judgment of your worth.

path.heading: It all starts with you
path.intro: You don’t need to know anything about chakras or frequencies to start raising your vibration. It all starts with yourself and with everyday life: how you think about yourself and others, the words you use, the way you act. Thoughts shape words, words shape actions, actions become habits, habits become a way of life, and a way of life creates destiny. Every link vibrates — and every link can be lifted.
path.chainCaption: Tap a link to see what it looks like at a lower and a higher vibration, plus a small practice for today.
path.stancesHeading: From which position do you live?
path.stancesCaption: The same day can be lived on four different levels: life happening to me, by me, through me, or as me. Notice which voice speaks in you most often.
path.bridge: As you begin noticing your thoughts, words and stances, the map below will help you see where your energy lives today and which practices help it rise.

zodiac.title: The Zodiac
zodiac.intro: Twelve archetypes, four elements, three modalities — the zodiac is an ancient map of human nature. Find your sign by birth date, explore its strengths, shadows and spiritual lessons, check your compatibility, and discover practices that support your energy.

finder.heading: Find Your Sign
finder.intro: Enter your date of birth to discover your Sun sign, its element, and your Chinese zodiac animal.
finder.label: Date of birth
finder.cusp: You were born near the cusp — depending on the exact year and time, you may also carry qualities of {sign}. A full birth chart gives the precise answer.
finder.chineseNote: The Chinese year starts at Lunar New Year (late Jan – mid Feb). If you were born in January or early February, check the previous year’s animal too.

zodiac.signsCaption: Tap a sign to read its full profile.
zodiac.elementsCaption: Every sign belongs to one element — the basic temperament of its energy.
zodiac.modalitiesCaption: Modality describes how a sign moves: starting, sustaining or transforming.

compat.heading: Compatibility
compat.intro: Choose two signs to see how their energies meet, based on the classical aspects of the zodiac wheel.

profile.practicesCaption: Techniques from our library that balance and support this sign’s energy.

disclaimer.title: A Mirror, Not a Destiny
disclaimer.text: Astrology is a symbolic, contemplative tradition — not a science. Your Sun sign is only one part of a full birth chart (Moon, Ascendant and planets matter too). Use these descriptions as prompts for self-reflection, never as fixed labels.

getApp.title: Take ConsciousEnergy with you
getApp.subtitle: Install ConsciousEnergy on your phone, tablet, or computer. It opens like any other app, works offline, and never needs an app store.

fast.title: Opens instantly
fast.text: Launches from your home screen or dock — no browser tabs to find.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Techniques you've opened stay available even without a connection.

home.title: Lives on your device
home.text: Sits alongside your other apps, with its own icon and window.

getApp.howSubtitle: Pick your device for step-by-step instructions.

ios.label: iPhone & iPad
steps: Tap the Share icon in the toolbar (the square with an arrow pointing up).
Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
Tap "Add" — ConsciousEnergy now appears on your home screen.

android.label: Android
steps: Tap the menu icon (⋮) in the top-right corner.
Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
Confirm — ConsciousEnergy is installed and ready to open anytime.

desktop.label: Desktop
steps: Open this website in Chrome, Edge, or another Chromium-based browser.
Look for the install icon in the address bar (a monitor with a down arrow).
ConsciousEnergy opens in its own window and is added to your apps.
